en: {spk:0180}{fa:0080}{n}...Sievas? Rare to see you in a place like this.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Ah, Reiv. For both of us, I suppose the past is the past and now is now.{n}{wait}{clear}Well, if we get the chance, let's sit down and talk. Someday.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0080}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hey, miss. Sorry to stop you when you're in a hurry, but could you tell me the way?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Huh? Um... I'm sorry. I only got here yesterday myself.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I see... Never mind, then. By the way, miss, are you on your own?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. I have my reasons...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I see. Still, a girl like you shouldn't be traveling alone. It's dangerous out there, all sorts of ways.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, I know, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Ah, never mind. I'm sure you've got your reasons. See you. Take care of yourself.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Reiv!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Sievas...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Are you all right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}...Yes. I was surprised... though if anyone qualifies, it's you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Just don't make people worry so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Well, fine. I'll count this one as a favor you owe me.{n}{wait}{clear}You can pay me back someday.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Of course... Though you're the last man I wanted to owe anything to...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Heh. If you can say things like that, I've got nothing left to worry about.{n}{wait}{clear}Well, see you again, Reiv.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}...Sir Griffin?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Huh? I intend to repay this debt someday.{n}{wait}{clear}If there's anything I can do...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}...Well, I don't mind hearing that...{n}{wait}{clear}It's just that, personally, I've got my reasons for not getting too friendly with a Knight Commander.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}So forget about it, okay? See you.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Sir... Felimi?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Oh, you're the man from the other day... Um... And when someone's in trouble, we help each other.{n}{wait}{clear}Well, I'll be going now.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. Thank you, truly.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}You are... Sir Dian?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}...Yes. And you're the man from the other day... Sir Reiv, if I remember right.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Forgive me for what happened the other day. I apologize.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}No, it's enough that you saved me.{n}{wait}{clear}And I will repay this debt, in some form, without fail. Would that be acceptable?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}No, please don't worry about something like that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}No. Otherwise I couldn't rest easy...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I see... Then, if something ever happens to me...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, understood. I won't forget.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}...You're the one from that time...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Oh! It's the knight from the other day!! Are you okay now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, thanks to you. ...I owe you my thanks.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Aw, come on. Don't worry about it. It's a promise.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Really? Hehe, that makes me kind of happy.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Well, let's meet again someday.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Okay! See you, mister!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}You're... Sir Ryudral?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Huh? Oh, you're... the one from that time.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}I left without a word the other day. Don't worry about that.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}I only did what a hero should...{n}{wait}{clear}Besides, if our places were switched, you'd have done the same, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Perhaps, but it doesn't change the fact that you saved me.{n}{wait}{clear}I'll repay this debt to you soon, I'm sure.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hey, let's drop the formalities. Let's say if something ever happens to me, then. That works, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes... When that time comes, without fail.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}See you, Knight Commander!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}...You're Lady Fiana?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Oh, you're the Knight Commander from the other day?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}I'm sorry about that time. ...I'm in your debt.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Forget it, it's fine. Then tell me if you hear about any bounties.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Something like that is hardly...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}It's fine. That's plenty for me. {spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Why, Lady Ashe...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Oh? Fancy meeting you here. The Knight Commander of Voras.{n}{wait}{clear}So you're feeling better. But the fact is, I now owe you a debt.{n}{wait}{clear}I intend to repay it someday without fail.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Hmm... You really are the man who leads a whole kingdom's knights.{n}{wait}{clear}Then I'll take you up on that and call it a favor you owe me.{n}{wait}{clear}If anything happens to me, come and help me, okay?{n}{wait}{clear}Does that work?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}Yes. I will keep that promise without fail.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Good. Then I'm counting on you when that time comes.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0180}{fa:0180}{n}...Sir Beasia?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{fa:0080}{n}Huh? Oh, it's just you.
